title: Russian FHIR Semantic Model IG
introduction: IG for semantic data model based on FHIR.

list.desc: Draft release consolidating OMS payment-document and policy-kind classification into one identifier with two required codings across profiles, examples, and GOST text.
Draft release documenting INN as the Russian tax identifier system and its semantic classification by the HL7 TAX identifier type in NamingSystem metadata, profiles, and GOST text.
Draft release adding a general coverage-document layer for payment documents, keeping the specialized OMS policy slice, and normalizing related NamingSystem URIs and documentation.
Draft patch release updating the GOST sync marker and documenting SNILS, OGRN, and INN NamingSystem alias identifiers alongside the current RuCore model.
Draft patch release refining human-readable descriptions for OMS policy kind coding and related GOST text while preserving the 0.11.0 contract.

Draft release removing misleading HL7 identifier type codes from RuCore profiles and examples except TAX for INN, and enriching SNILS, OGRN, and INN NamingSystems with their widely used Russian OID and urn:oid aliases.
Draft release switching OMS policy type and medical care payment source terminology to the corresponding main NSI dictionaries.
Draft patch release correcting NSI CodeSystem descriptions so human-facing links point to the corresponding NSI dictionaries while preserving RuCore canonical URLs.
Draft release aligning OMS policy identifier slices with base FHIR cardinalities by making Identifier.type optional and allowing either HL7 or NSI coding when type is present.

Draft release aligning RuCore slicing with interoperability-first rules by relaxing Core_Coverage omsPolicy type coding so downstream guides are not forced to use both HL7 and NSI codings simultaneously.
Draft release relaxing national terminology bindings to extensible and normalizing canonical identifier system URIs, NamingSystems, and examples across RuCore.
Draft release restoring the full FHIR R5 reference target sets in core workflow profiles while keeping RuCore profiles for those resource types that RuCore defines.

Draft release replacing the local RelatedPerson relationship terminology with a ValueSet built from NSI codes, since RuCore should not take responsibility for maintaining a dedicated relationship CodeSystem.
Draft patch release refining RelatedPerson mapping pages with named terminology links and populated ConceptMap scope metadata.
Draft patch release adding intro-page navigation from the RelatedPerson CodeSystem to its ConceptMap mappings.
Draft release with revised RelatedPerson relationship terminology: canonical RuCore CodeSystem, explicit ConceptMap mappings to HL7 and NSI, and documented ValueSet usage in chapter 5.
Draft release with revised handling of Russian addresses: Core_Address applies to addresses on the territory of the Russian Federation; foreign addresses use the base Address datatype.
